name: dual-lobe-omission-benchmark
notice: Synthetic cases. All people, identifiers and records are fictitious. Gold labels were drafted by the author from the cited label-level sources (gold.basis) and MUST be confirmed by independent clinician review before any result is reported. See benchmarks/clinical/DATASHEET.md.

cases.question: Knee osteoarthritis flare. What ibuprofen dose should I prescribe?

record.note: Mr. Hargrove reports right knee pain for 2 weeks. His daughter Priya manages his pill box.

gold.summary: NSAID with ACE inhibitor + loop diuretic in CKD stage 4: high risk of acute kidney injury; avoid systemic NSAIDs.
gold.basis: KDIGO CKD guidance and NSAID labelling: avoid NSAIDs in advanced CKD; ACE inhibitor + diuretic + NSAID combination increases acute kidney injury risk.

cases.question: Outpatient community-acquired pneumonia, no comorbid lung disease. Is clarithromycin 500 mg twice daily for 7 days reasonable?

gold.summary: Clarithromycin is a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor; co-administration with simvastatin is contraindicated (rhabdomyolysis). Hold the statin or choose another antibiotic.
gold.basis: Simvastatin US prescribing information: contraindicated with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors including clarithromycin.

cases.question: Acute bacterial sinusitis, symptoms 12 days. Amoxicillin-clavulanate dose for an adult?

record.note: Mr. Okoro works night shifts. Facial pain and purulent discharge.

gold.summary: Documented penicillin anaphylaxis: amoxicillin-clavulanate is contraindicated; use a non-beta-lactam alternative.
gold.basis: Amoxicillin-clavulanate prescribing information: contraindicated with history of serious hypersensitivity (anaphylaxis) to penicillins.

cases.question: Blood pressure 152/96 on two visits. Start lisinopril 10 mg daily?

record.note: LMP 9 weeks ago. Home pregnancy test positive last week; booking visit not yet arranged. Lives with her partner Jonas.

gold.summary: Probable early pregnancy: ACE inhibitors are contraindicated (fetotoxicity). Confirm pregnancy; use a pregnancy-compatible antihypertensive and refer to antenatal care.
gold.basis: ACE inhibitor labelling (boxed warning): fetal toxicity; discontinue when pregnancy is detected.

cases.question: New type 2 diabetes, HbA1c 8.1%. Start metformin 500 mg twice daily?

gold.summary: Metformin is contraindicated at eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2 (lactic acidosis risk). Choose another agent.
gold.basis: FDA Drug Safety Communication (2016) and metformin labelling: contraindicated with eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2.

cases.question: Moderate mechanical low back pain. Tramadol 50 mg every 6 hours as needed?

gold.summary: Tramadol with sertraline and trazodone raises the risk of serotonin syndrome (and lowers seizure threshold). Prefer a non-serotonergic analgesic.
gold.basis: Tramadol prescribing information: serotonin syndrome risk with SSRIs and other serotonergic drugs; seizure risk.

cases.question: Recurrent migraine without aura, 3-4 attacks a month. Start sumatriptan 50 mg at onset?

history: NSTEMI 2 years ago, drug-eluting stent to LAD

gold.summary: Triptans are contraindicated in ischaemic heart disease (prior NSTEMI with stent). Use a non-vasoconstrictive option.
gold.basis: Sumatriptan prescribing information: contraindicated in ischaemic coronary artery disease and history of myocardial infarction.

cases.question: Erectile dysfunction. Sildenafil 50 mg as needed?

gold.summary: PDE5 inhibitors are contraindicated with nitrates (severe hypotension).
gold.basis: Sildenafil prescribing information: contraindicated with organic nitrates.

cases.question: Post-tonsillectomy pain. Acetaminophen with codeine dose, please?

record.note: Tonsillectomy for obstructive sleep apnoea on 2026-09-25. Mother Kim Tran at bedside.

gold.summary: Codeine is contraindicated in children under 12 and after tonsillectomy/adenoidectomy in under-18s (fatal respiratory depression in ultra-rapid metabolisers).
gold.basis: FDA Drug Safety Communication (April 2017): codeine contraindicated in children under 12 and after tonsillectomy/adenoidectomy in under-18s.

cases.question: INR has been hard to keep in range on warfarin for his atrial fibrillation. Switch to apixaban 5 mg twice daily?

gold.summary: DOACs are contraindicated with mechanical heart valves; stay on a vitamin K antagonist and address INR control.
gold.basis: Apixaban labelling and RE-ALIGN trial (dabigatran): DOACs not recommended/contraindicated with mechanical heart valves.

cases.question: Performance anxiety before presentations. Propranolol 20 mg an hour before?

problems: asthma: 2 emergency visits in the past year, uses salbutamol most days

gold.summary: Non-selective beta-blockers such as propranolol can precipitate severe bronchospasm in asthma; avoid.
gold.basis: Propranolol prescribing information: contraindicated in bronchial asthma.

cases.question: Bipolar I disorder, current manic episode. Start valproate?

record.note: Not using contraception. Says she and her fiance hope to start a family next year.

gold.summary: Valproate carries major teratogenic and neurodevelopmental risk; avoid in women of childbearing potential unless a pregnancy-prevention programme is in place.
gold.basis: Valproate boxed warning and regulatory pregnancy-prevention requirements: major congenital malformations and neurodevelopmental effects.

cases.question: Low back pain for 6 weeks. Refer to physiotherapy and give naproxen 500 mg twice daily?

history: breast cancer 2019, treated with surgery and chemotherapy
record.note: Unintentional weight loss of 6 kg over 3 months. Pain is worse at night and wakes her. Walks her neighbour's dog in Riverside Park.

gold.summary: History of cancer, weight loss and night pain are red flags for spinal metastasis: urgent imaging before conservative management.
gold.basis: Low back pain guidelines (e.g. NICE NG59, ACP 2017): history of cancer, unexplained weight loss and night pain are red flags warranting investigation.

cases.question: Please renew his amlodipine 5 mg for 90 days.

gold.summary: Potassium 6.4 mmol/L on an ACE inhibitor + spironolactone needs same-day action (ECG, stop/adjust drugs), whatever the refill request.
gold.basis: Hyperkalaemia management guidance: potassium >= 6.0 mmol/L requires urgent assessment (ECG, review of RAAS inhibitors and potassium-sparing diuretics).

cases.question: Right lower quadrant pain. Order a CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast?

record.note: LMP about 7 weeks ago; sexually active; no contraception. Pain since this morning, nausea.

gold.summary: Possible pregnancy (and ectopic pregnancy) must be excluded with hCG before CT; consider ultrasound first.
gold.basis: ACR Appropriateness Criteria / radiology practice: pregnancy status should be established before CT of the abdomen and pelvis in patients of childbearing potential.

cases.question: Recurrent gout attacks. Start allopurinol 100 mg daily?

gold.summary: Allopurinol blocks azathioprine metabolism (xanthine oxidase), causing severe myelosuppression; avoid or reduce azathioprine substantially with specialist input.
gold.basis: Azathioprine prescribing information: reduce dose to one-third to one-quarter with allopurinol (xanthine oxidase inhibition) because of myelotoxicity.

cases.question: Trouble falling asleep. Diphenhydramine 50 mg at night?

problems: benign prostatic hyperplasia with urinary retention episode last month

gold.summary: Strongly anticholinergic sedative in an 84-year-old with dementia and urinary retention (and on donepezil): avoid (Beers criteria).
gold.basis: 2023 AGS Beers Criteria: avoid first-generation antihistamines (strongly anticholinergic) in older adults, especially with dementia or urinary retention.

cases.question: Uncomplicated cystitis. Ciprofloxacin 250 mg twice daily for 3 days?

gold.summary: Fluoroquinolone in a 79-year-old on corticosteroids: high risk of tendon rupture (boxed warning); also not first-line for uncomplicated cystitis.
gold.basis: Fluoroquinolone boxed warning: increased tendon rupture risk, higher in patients over 60 and with corticosteroids; not first-line for uncomplicated cystitis.

cases.question: Uncomplicated UTI. Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole DS twice daily for 3 days?

record.note: His wife Elif phones in the INR results.

gold.summary: TMP-SMX markedly potentiates warfarin (INR rise, bleeding); choose another antibiotic or monitor INR closely.
gold.basis: Warfarin prescribing information and interaction references: sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim markedly increases INR and bleeding risk.

cases.question: MRSA bacteraemia. What IV vancomycin dose should I give?

record.note: Admitted from clinic today. Weight and renal function not yet recorded.

gold.summary: Vancomycin dosing needs body weight and renal function, both missing: obtain them (and plan level/AUC monitoring) before a definitive dose.
gold.basis: IDSA/ASHP/SIDP vancomycin consensus guideline (2020): weight-based loading and renal function-based maintenance dosing with AUC monitoring.

cases.question: Confirmed proximal DVT. Enoxaparin treatment dose?

problems: proximal DVT left leg, confirmed on ultrasound
record.note: No bloods drawn yet. Weight not recorded.

gold.summary: Enoxaparin treatment dose is weight-based and renally adjusted; weight, renal function and platelet count are missing.
gold.basis: Enoxaparin prescribing information: treatment dose is weight-based and adjusted for creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min; platelet monitoring.
